item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.28)] Drones Tracked in Miami Area Using Existing 5G Network
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Bullish (+0.28)
Lockheed Martin, in collaboration with Verizon, NVIDIA, Keysight Technologies, ODC, and Astris AI, successfully demonstrated the NetSense Airspace Awareness-as-a-Service system in Miami. This system uses existing 5G networks and AI to detect, track, and monitor unmanned aircraft systems (UAS) in real time without requiring changes to cellular radio deployments. The subscription-based service is aimed at protecting critical infrastructure and public venues, with pilot deployments expected in late 2026 to early 2027 and broader commercial availability in 2027.
